marc:datafield.marc:subfield: The aftermath of World War III, after a series of chemical and nuclear bomb attacks, set off a plague that kills most of the adult population, leaving only the young ones behind. As the young children grow up without any proper guidance, they are separated into five main clans which are Merah Putih led by X (Farid Kamil), Taring led by Sri Gala (Peter Davies), Flora led by Kulat (Zoe Tan), Teratai led by Melur (Vasanth) and Jengking led by Y (Jehan Miskin). As the power struggle between the five clans escalate, everyone realises that only the strong will survive.
